title: The Fort in the Yard
lines: Ben and Pam start a fort in the yard.
The fort is a big box and a card.
The card will not stand up by itself.
Pam props it up with a short stick.
Dad hands Ben a lamp for the dark part.
Then a big dog jumps on the fort.
It drops flat and Pam is sad.
Ben starts to prop the card back up.
The card falls flat, so Pam stops to think.
She sets a rock on the short stick.
The fort stands, and the dog naps in it.

questions.ask: What made the fort drop flat?
questions.listenFor: The big dog jumped on it. Send them back to that line if they guess.

questions.ask: How did Pam get the card to stand up the second time?
questions.listenFor: She set a rock on the short stick. If they say "Ben propped it," ask "did it stay up?"

questions.ask: Pam set a rock on the stick. What else could have held the card up?
questions.listenFor: Any idea. Line four is her first prop; line ten is the rock. Ask why the card kept falling.
